ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, in Memories, tap "Idea" under an entry with VoiceOver or TalkBack off and then on; open the entry, tap "Happy" under the viewer's info line. **Expect:** "Idea" is its own target inside the entry's button, said as a link named "Ideas", and opens the Ideas lens; Back returns to the journal; in the viewer, the native Modal closes first and the Happy moments lens opens with no flash of the journal (RL1-RL5, decision 0177)

argv: on a phone, in Memories, tap "Idea" under an entry
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, react to a moment with two families at once from a new note's page (Happy, then Idea, before any words), keep the note, and quit the app while it saves; also react to a video and look at its pin. **Expect:** the moment has both reactions or neither, never one (`setReactions` in one SQLite transaction through the write queue, RL10, RL11); the video pin's bubbles sit in an L at its left, the third above the first, none over the play mark nor clipped by the Marker on Android (RL12)

- [loop] **Reaction links** (UI review U3, U5): a reaction panel does not say which moment it acts on (a subtitle with the moment's first words, or the entry scrolled into view above the sheet); Neutral's circled minus reads as "remove" now that a mark is tappable (Ionicons has no neutral face; a drawn one, or another glyph, is a choice for a phone).

ops.intro: What the reaction-links slice left for the owner (`specs/reaction-links/spec.md`, Record).

ops.body: - **Back from a lens opened from the viewer** (UI review U6): a reaction in the viewer closes it and opens its lens (RL3), so Back returns to the journal, not to the moment that was open. Recommended: keep it (the lens is a new place, and the moment is one tap away in the journal); the alternative is that Back reopens the viewer on that moment.
